paragraphs: The Discovery SDV6 was introduced as a higher-output variant of the 3.0-litre V6 diesel that powered the D3 and D4 generations of the Discovery. Essentially a more powerful tune of the same 3.0-litre V6 shared with the TDV6, the SDV6 offered improved performance while sitting on the same engine architecture. It was fitted across both the D3 (2004–2009) and D4 (2009–2016) generations, making it one of the most common Discovery engines of that era.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace SDV6 engines for every Discovery SDV6 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre V6 diesel fitted to the Discovery D3 and D4 from 2004 to 2016.
